overview.description: The YieldMax Target 12 Semiconductor Option Income ETF (SOXY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that targets an annual income level of 12% by investing in US semiconductor companies while employing a covered call strategy. SOXY was launched on Dec 2, 2024 and is issued by YieldMax.
